newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Banco BBA 1st half net 54.05 mln reais.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Banco BBA 1st half net 54.05 mln reais.

text.p: Brazilian private bank Banco BBA Creditanstalt posted a net profit of 54.05 million reais, or 0.17 real per share, in the first half of 1997, according to financial results published Tuesday.
The bank's operating revenues totalled 457.5 million reais.
It ended the January-to-June period with total assets of 6.036 billion reais and a net worth of 453 million reais.
Banco BBA is an investment bank whose main shareholders are Fernao Bracher, Antonio Beltran and Austria's Creditanstalt-Bankverein, which owns 49 percent of the local bank.
